answer: Each challenge is cryptographically bound to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: until drand publishes the committed round, its unpredictable, unbiasable value is unknown and cannot be chosen by either requester or solver. Consequently, a sybil swarm cannot pre-compute task catalogs or farm answers offline; commit-reveal binds each response to that pulse. Even a tide, pearl, or vertex label changes the transcript without creating reusable work.
